column2: Your family were outcasts, due to having unintentionally spread a terrible contagion among your people. What was the nature of that disease? Why did your siblings always believe your family was unjustly blamed? And why have you always been immune to the effects of the sickness? Add +10 to Heal or Insight.

You studied the ways of the Weave under the tutelage of a reclusive mentor. One day, you were left alone to observe a summoned entity. The strain tested your mental fortitude as the being attempted to break free. What was the nature of the entity? Did you succeed in holding it at bay, or did it escape? What mark did the encounter leave on you? If you plan to choose the Spellweaver career, add +10 to Bind: Control; if not, add +10 to Willpower or Arcana.

You charmed, distracted, or gained the trust of someone in possession of a valuable item, long enough to lay your hands on it without their notice. What was the item? How did you get away? And what strong emotion do you still feel for the person you decieved? Add +10 to Locks & Traps or Seduce.
